fork.definition:
n. cutlery used for serving and eating food
n. the region of the angle formed by the junction of two branches
n. an agricultural tool used for lifting or digging; has a handle and metal prongs
v. place under attack with one's own pieces, of two enemy pieces
fork.translation:
n. 叉子, 叉状物, 分岔
vi. 分支, 分歧
vt. 做成叉形, 叉起
[计] 派生指令

fork over.translation: 整平, 移动; 付钱

fork up the roots.translation: 把根耙出,连根拔除,根除

fork(lift) truck.translation: [化] 叉式起重车; 铲车

fork-like.definition: s resembling a fork; divided or separated into two branches

forked.definition:
v lift with a pitchfork
v place under attack with one's own pieces, of two enemy pieces
v divide into two or more branches so as to form a fork
v shape like a fork
s resembling a fork; divided or separated into two branches
s having two meanings with intent to deceive
forked.translation:
a. 成叉的, 叉的, 叉状的
[医] 叉状的

forked tongue.translation: <美>欺人之谈, 假话, 谎话

forked working.translation: [计] 交叉工作, 发支工作

forkhead.translation: 带两个有时带三个前指尖头的箭头

forkiness.definition: n. The quality or state or dividing in a forklike manner.

forking.definition:
n the place where something divides into branches
n the act of branching out or dividing into branches
v lift with a pitchfork
v place under attack with one's own pieces, of two enemy pieces
v divide into two or more branches so as to form a fork
v shape like a fork
forking.translation: v. 分支；分叉；河流分岔作用（fork的ing形式）

forklift.definition: n. a small industrial vehicle with a power operated forked platform in front that can be inserted under loads to lift and move them
forklift.translation: n. 铲车, 叉式升降机

forklift truck.translation: 叉式升降装卸车, 叉车, 铲车

forklifts.definition:
plural of forklift
n. a small industrial vehicle with a power operated forked platform in front that can be inserted under loads to lift and move them
forklifts.translation: (forklift 的复数) n. 铲车, 叉式升降机

forktail.definition:
n. One of several Asiatic and East Indian passerine birds,
   belonging to Enucurus, and allied genera. The tail is deeply forking.
n. A salmon in its fourth year's growth.
forktail.translation: n. 尾巴开叉的鱼, 尾巴开叉的鸟

forky.definition: a. Opening into two or more parts or shoots; forked; furcated.
forky.translation: a. 分叉的, 分歧的
